critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1523 lines — should be split into routers/modules for maintainability.

AGENT_PASSWORD default 'Agent@2024!' in server.py line 226 falls back to a hardcoded value if AGENT_PASSWORD env var is missing — acceptable for a shared agent gate but should be documented; prefer failing fast in prod.
InvoicingAgent.jsx auto-login hardcodes admin email — should be env-driven.
Startup try/except now correctly swallows Atlas connectivity errors so the server stays up; log the exception so silent failures are detectable.
Deferred _maybe_ensure_indices() pattern in banking_agent.py is a solid fix; consider applying the same lazy pattern to other routers that touch Mongo at import time.
